name: ProtectedViewWindows
description: Represents a collection of ProtectedViewWindow objects.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single ProtectedViewWindow object from the specified ProtectedViewWindows collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single ProtectedViewWindow object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open(FileName As String, [ReadPassword As String], [OpenAndRepair As MsoTriState]) As ProtectedViewWindow
methods.description: Open and return a ProtectedViewWindow object from the ProtectedViewWindows collection.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to open.

parameters.name: ReadPassword
parameters.description: The password to use for the protected file.

parameters.name: OpenAndRepair
parameters.description: Indicates whether to repair the file.
